name: Countdown Timer Builder
summary: Build a live countdown to any date — preview, theme it, and download self-contained HTML.
description: Set a target date/time, title, subtitle, and which units to show. Preview the countdown live, tweak accent colors, then copy or download a self-contained HTML page with an inline timer. No external scripts required.

faqs.question: What does the download include?
faqs.answer: A single HTML file with CSS and a small script that updates every second. Host it anywhere static files work.

faqs.question: Which timezone is used?
faqs.answer: The picker uses your local timezone; the embed stores an absolute ISO timestamp so visitors count down to the same instant.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Preview and HTML generation run entirely in your browser.
